mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at 47 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library and a full moon tonight. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is seeking public feedback on the US 18/151 Corridor Study between Dodgeville and Fitchburg. You can attend an in-person meeting on November 18 at Mount Horeb High School or join the virtual session on November 19 to review design concepts and share your thoughts.

There is a lot of local fun happening. Today you can find trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, check out live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or trivia at The Bogey Factory.

In a recent incident on October 23, two 13-year-olds were observed riding prohibited eMotos. Officers made contact with the juveniles, who had been previously warned, and subsequently cited their parents for permitting a minor to drive a motor vehicle.
If you are craving something sweet, today's flavor is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is currently closed, but you can head over when they open today at 10:00 AM.
